Elevated earnings with your salary transfer

Open your account today

Earn high interest by simply transferring your salary to Emirates NBD. You can earn even more with a credit card.

Earn interest in 3 simple steps

1 Open an eligible Emirates NBD account

2 Transfer your salary of  10,000 or more

3 Maintain a monthly average balance of  25,000

Earn bonus interest

To make your salary transfer even more rewarding, you can earn 0.50% more if you get a credit card and spend a minimum of  10,000 on the new card within 60 days of opening your account.

Base interest p.a. Bonus interest p.a.
Emiratis 5.50% 6%
Residents 5% 5.50%
  • Interest is calculated on average monthly balances
  • The reward period is 6 months from the account opening

Bank and earn guaranteed cashback

Get eligible products to earn cashback of up to  6,000.

Learn more

Eligibility

Who is eligible? *

  • All individuals opening their first-ever Emirates NBD account during the campaign period
  • If you have an Emirates NBD account and haven't transferred your salary to Emirates NBD in the past six months, you can enrol in the promotion.

Eligible accounts for salary transfers

  • Millionaire accounts
  • Current Account
  • Savings Account

*For more information, please refer to the promotion’s terms and conditions

Enjoy additional benefits by banking with Emirates NBD

Win from  50,000,000 in monthly cash prizes with any Millionaire Account

Avail special loan rates when you transfer your salary

Enjoy free international transfers to many countries
